newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down 11 cents as LME drops.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down 11 cents as LME drops.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down 11 cents at 14.45 ringgit ($5.79) a kg, pressured by a $115 drop on the the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight.
Traders said the fall in London encouraged offers for 158 tonnes at the opening, against bids for 48 tonnes.
Final turnover was 104 tonnes, up from 91 on Tuesday, and buyers were from Europe and Malaysia.

Traders said in the absence of fresh fundamentals, the performance on the LME would continue to influence sentiment here. The local price premium over the LME narrowed to $20 a tonne against $30 previously. ($1=2.4960 ringgit)
